name: Steal a Generator!
desc:
💸 Welcome to Cashflow! 💸

⚡ Place generators, earn cash, and build your empire.
📈 Buy better generators for more money.
🧱 Build and defend epic bases with your friends.
🔨 Steal generators from rivals to dominate.
🏆 Rebirth and compete on the global leaderboards.

👍 Use code "8KLikes" for free Cash! Next code at 9K Likes.

⚠️ Watch out! ⚠️ Anybody can steal your generators.

😔 Private Servers generate money 5x slower.

💜 Thank you for playing!
